description_en: Creates a private traffic mirroring configuration for a specified VPC and selects the elastic network interfaces (ENIs) to connect. The operation is asynchronous and returns a task ID
description_zh: 为指定 VPC 创建私网引流配置，并选择要接入的弹性网卡。接口异步执行，返回任务 ID
kebab_example: aliyun ndr create-private-traction --vpc-instance-id vpc-bp1example --gwlbe-vsw-info-list ZoneId=cn-hangzhou-h CidrBlock=10.0.0.0/24 VswInstanceId=vsw-bp1example --max-bandwidth 20 --max-traffic='-1' --time-config 00:00_23:59_0_0 --eni-instance-id-list eni-bp1example --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreatePrivateTraction

fields.help_en: The vSwitch CIDR block. This parameter is required when you create a new vSwitch
fields.help_zh: 交换机网段。创建新交换机时必填
fields.name: cidr_block

fields.help_en: The vSwitch instance ID. This parameter is required when you use an existing vSwitch
fields.help_zh: 交换机实例 ID。使用已有交换机时必填
fields.name: vsw_instance_id

fields.help_en: The zone ID
fields.help_zh: 可用区 ID
fields.name: zone_id

parameters.help_en: The list of vSwitch configurations used by the Gateway Load Balancer endpoint (GWLBe). The list must contain one to two entries in different zones
parameters.help_zh: 网关负载均衡终端节点使用的交换机配置列表，必须包含 1～2 个不同可用区
parameters.name: gwlbe_vsw_info_list

parameters.help_en: The private traffic mirroring bandwidth, in Gbps. Valid values: 10 to 50. The value must be a multiple of 10
parameters.help_zh: 私网引流带宽，单位为 Gbps。创建或修改配置时取值为 10～50，且必须为 10 的整数倍
parameters.name: max_bandwidth

parameters.help_en: The upper limit of private traffic mirroring, in GB. A value of -1 indicates no limit
parameters.help_zh: 私网引流流量上限，单位为 GB。-1 表示不限制
parameters.name: max_traffic

parameters.help_en: The time configuration for traffic mirroring. You can specify a fixed start time and end time, or configure a recurring schedule by start time, end time, day of the week, and date. For example, 00:00 23:59 * * indicates all-day execution every day. You cannot specify both day of the week and date at the same time
parameters.help_zh: 引流时间配置。支持固定起止时间，或按开始时间、结束时间、星期和日期设置周期，例如 00:00 23:59 * * 表示每天全天执行。星期与日期不能同时限定
parameters.name: time_config

parameters.help_en: The list of elastic network interface (ENI) instance IDs
parameters.help_zh: 弹性网卡实例 ID 列表
parameters.name: eni_instance_id_list

fields.help_en: The destination CIDR block in CIDR notation. A value of 0.0.0.0/0 indicates all IPv4 addresses
fields.help_zh: 目的地址网段，使用 CIDR 格式；0.0.0.0/0 表示全部 IPv4 地址
fields.name: destination_cidr_block

fields.help_en: The destination port range in the format of start port/end port, such as 80/443. A value of -1/-1 indicates all ports. This parameter is required for TCP or UDP
fields.help_zh: 目的端口范围，格式为 起始端口/结束端口，例如 80/443；-1/-1 表示全部端口。TCP 或 UDP 协议必填
fields.name: destination_port_range

fields.help_en: The sub-rule priority. Valid values: 1 to 16777216. A smaller value indicates a higher priority. The priority must be unique within the same direction
fields.help_zh: 子规则优先级，取值范围为 1～16777216。数字越小，优先级越高；同一方向内优先级不可重复
fields.name: priority

fields.help_en:
The network protocol to match. Valid values:
ALL: all protocols.
ICMP: ICMP.
TCP: TCP.
UDP: UDP
fields.help_zh: 匹配的网络协议。ALL 表示全部协议，ICMP、TCP、UDP 表示对应协议
fields.name: protocol

fields.help_en: The source CIDR block in CIDR notation. A value of 0.0.0.0/0 indicates all IPv4 addresses
fields.help_zh: 源地址网段，使用 CIDR 格式；0.0.0.0/0 表示全部 IPv4 地址
fields.name: source_cidr_block

fields.help_en: The source port range in the format of start port/end port, such as 80/443. A value of -1/-1 indicates all ports. This parameter is required for TCP or UDP
fields.help_zh: 源端口范围，格式为 起始端口/结束端口，例如 80/443；-1/-1 表示全部端口。TCP 或 UDP 协议必填
fields.name: source_port_range

fields.help_en:
The action to take on matched traffic. Valid values:
accept: collects the traffic.
drop: does not collect the traffic
fields.help_zh: 匹配流量的处理动作。accept 表示采集，drop 表示不采集
fields.name: sub_rule_action

fields.help_en: The list of outbound filter sub-rules
fields.help_zh: 出方向过滤子规则列表
fields.name: egress_sub_rules

fields.help_en: The destination CIDR block in CIDR notation. A value of 0.0.0.0/0 indicates all IPv4 addresses
fields.help_zh: 目的地址网段，使用 CIDR 格式；0.0.0.0/0 表示全部 IPv4 地址
fields.name: destination_cidr_block

fields.help_en: The destination port range in the format of start port/end port, such as 80/443. A value of -1/-1 indicates all ports. This parameter is required for TCP or UDP
fields.help_zh: 目的端口范围，格式为 起始端口/结束端口，例如 80/443；-1/-1 表示全部端口。TCP 或 UDP 协议必填
fields.name: destination_port_range

fields.help_en: The sub-rule priority. Valid values: 1 to 16777216. A smaller value indicates a higher priority. The priority must be unique within the same direction
fields.help_zh: 子规则优先级，取值范围为 1～16777216。数字越小，优先级越高；同一方向内优先级不可重复
fields.name: priority

fields.help_en:
The network protocol to match. Valid values:
ALL: all protocols.
ICMP: ICMP.
TCP: TCP.
UDP: UDP
fields.help_zh: 匹配的网络协议。ALL 表示全部协议，ICMP、TCP、UDP 表示对应协议
fields.name: protocol

fields.help_en: The source CIDR block in CIDR notation. A value of 0.0.0.0/0 indicates all IPv4 addresses
fields.help_zh: 源地址网段，使用 CIDR 格式；0.0.0.0/0 表示全部 IPv4 地址
fields.name: source_cidr_block

fields.help_en: The source port range in the format of start port/end port, such as 80/443. A value of -1/-1 indicates all ports. This parameter is required for TCP or UDP
fields.help_zh: 源端口范围，格式为 起始端口/结束端口，例如 80/443；-1/-1 表示全部端口。TCP 或 UDP 协议必填
fields.name: source_port_range

fields.help_en:
The action to take on matched traffic. Valid values:
accept: collects the traffic.
drop: does not collect the traffic
fields.help_zh: 匹配流量的处理动作。accept 表示采集，drop 表示不采集
fields.name: sub_rule_action

fields.help_en: The list of inbound filter sub-rules
fields.help_zh: 入方向过滤子规则列表
fields.name: ingress_sub_rules

fields.example: 采集指定网段的 TCP 流量
fields.help_en: The filter rule description. The description must be fewer than 256 characters and cannot start with http:// or https://
fields.help_zh: 过滤规则描述。少于 256 个字符，不能以 http:// 或 https:// 开头
fields.name: rule_description

fields.help_en: The filter rule name. The name must be fewer than 128 characters and cannot start with http:// or https://
fields.help_zh: 过滤规则名称。少于 128 个字符，不能以 http:// 或 https:// 开头
fields.name: rule_name

parameters.help_en: The filter rule snapshot used by new traffic mirror sessions. If not specified, all traffic is collected. This does not replace the filter rules of existing traffic mirror sessions
parameters.help_zh: 新建镜像会话使用的过滤规则快照。不传时采集全部流量；不会替换已有镜像会话的过滤规则
parameters.name: filter_rule

PrivateTractionId.description_en: The private traffic mirroring configuration ID

PrivateTractionTaskId.description_en: The asynchronous task ID for private traffic mirroring
PrivateTractionTaskId.description_zh: 私网引流异步任务 ID
